messages:
incident-bot: [pagerduty] P1 - PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-api-canary. Alert: 5xx-rate > 5% over 2m. region=us-west-2. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-regress

pagerduty: Notification sent to on-call: alex (primary). Escalation in 5m if no ack.

alex: ack. I'm oncall, picking this up. seeing a spike in 5xx for /v1/generate from canary pool in us-west-2. tagging SRE.

morgan: on call SRE here — looking. Dashboard shows canary nodes 3/5 unhealthy, 5xx ~18% at peak.

sam: I just pushed a canary runtime image earlier: runtime:v2.7.2-canary -> rollout r-2026-03-14-09. Changes include attention kernel tweak + mem allocator.

alex: can you confirm which change could cause 5xx? stack traces point to `grpc: connection closed` and `runtime: OOM trying to allocate` on a few pods.

sam: hmm, mem allocator tweak may be aggressive. I'm attaching recent logs.

sam: ```
2026-03-14T09:10:21Z runtime error: failed to allocate 128MB: out of memory
handler=generate user_id=acct-123 route=/v1/generate node=canary-3
stack: goroutine 524 [running]:
...
```

alex: customer impact? Jordan, any support tickets?

jordan: flagged 4 customers with errors above threshold (ids: cust-A, cust-B, cust-C, cust-D). Some retries mitigated but latency up. I'm drafting a status page blurb.

liz: I'll prepare a short public status note: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors for a subset of requests in us-west-2. Engineers are on it."

morgan: immediate mitigation options: (1) pause canary traffic routing, (2) scale canary nodes down to 0 and route traffic to stable pool, (3) rollback canary to runtime:v2.7.1. Which do we want?

sam: prefer rollback to v2.7.1 on canary pool first. If rollback fails, do pool swap.

alex: executing rollback for canary pool now. command: `tools/deployctl rollback --pool=canary --image=runtime:v2.7.1 --rollout=r-2026-03-14-09`

alex: output: ```
Rolling back pool=canary to runtime:v2.7.1...
Pod canary-1 updated -> ready
Pod canary-2 updated -> ready
Pod canary-3 updated -> CrashLoopBackOff (retrying)
Pod canary-4 updated -> ready
Pod canary-5 updated -> ready
Rollback applied to 4/5 pods, one failing pod.
```

morgan: canary-3 still failing with OOM after rollback — looks like node-level resource issue. I'm going to cordon and drain canary-3 and force a node replace.

sam: executing `k8s scale --namespace=redwood --deployment=canary --replicas=6` to spin up extra pod to avoid capacity blips.

alex: temporarily directing traffic away from canary-3 by updating LB route: `lbctl weight set canary-3 0`.

jordan: customers updated: support notified cust-A/B/C with temporary workaround (retry/backoff) and that engineering is rolling back.

morgan: after drain and extra replicas, 5xx dropped from 18% -> 0.6% over 6 minutes. Good signal.

alex: monitoring - error rate back to baseline in us-west-2 (0.3%). I'll keep this thread open for 30m watch.

incident-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-345 and postmortem draft task assigned to alex, sam, morgan.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by alex.

liz: I'll post status update: "Mitigation in progress — traffic routed away from an affected canary node; rollback applied to canary pool; error rates trending down."

alex: note for postmortem: cause hypothesis = mem allocator change in runtime:v2.7.2-canary + insufficient headroom on canary nodes causing OOMs. action items: add canary node memory overhead check to rollout gates, add automated canary OOM detection to deploy bot.

sam: I'll revert the canary image in the registry and add a presubmit mem smoke test.

morgan: will check cluster autoscaler thresholds to avoid single-node overload during rollouts.

jordan: created support follow-ups to notify affected customers when incident closed.

alex: closing loop — error rate stable. final check: `curl -s https://internal-metrics/api/series?service=redwood-inference-api-canary | jq .errors_last_5m` -> `0.004` (0.4%).

alex: marking mitigated. Will set follow-up meeting for postmortem at 11:00 PST.

pagerduty: Incident resolved by alex. PagerDuty alert status: RESOLVED.

morgan: thumbs up. adding a canary-rollout checklist entry: verify memory headroom + OOM alerts. :thumbsup:

alex: starting the postmortem draft now. tagging @sam @morgan for action items. Thanks all for quick response.

incident-bot: This thread will be archived into INC-2026-345. If anything regresses, re-open thread or file follow-up.
